title: Sand On Tap
meta_description: From its unparalleled location just steps from the beach to the high-end amenities and luxurious design, Sand On Tap offers everything you need. Whether you seek relaxation on the beach, a dip in the community pool, or adventure along scenic bike paths.
description_expanded: DescriptionWhat Guests Love- Private beach access, steps from entry- Gulf views from multiple vantage points, a sunset must- Complete clean bedding program- 4 complimentary beach cruiser bikes- Outdoor dining and use of provided propane grill- Community pool- Prime Location - 2-minute bike ride to Rosemary Beach and 30Avenue for dining, shopping, and live music.- Private Parking - space for 3-4 cars (RV and trailer parking prohibited by HOA).- Sonos Sound System throughout the homeWelcome to Sand On Tap, your dream getaway in Inlet Beach, where luxury meets the laid-back charm of the Gulf Coast. This stunning beach home offers spectacular Gulf views and the perfect blend of contemporary elegance and coastal vibes, creating an unforgettable escape. Designed with comfort and style in mind, Sand On Tap boasts meticulously curated interiors, offering a spacious and serene atmosphere for you and your guests. Whether you're relaxing in the beautifully furnished living spaces or enjoying the breathtaking views from one of the private balconies, this home is the epitome of refined coastal living.Situated just steps from the exclusive Barberry Coast private beach access, Sand On Tap allows you to enjoy the soft, white sands and crystal-clear waters of the Gulf right at your doorstep. Beach service is available for neighborhood guests, adding extra convenience to your beachside experience.Take advantage of the complimentary bikes provided, making it easy to explore the picturesque surroundings at your leisure. A short 3-minute bike ride takes you to the vibrant Rosemary Beach and 30Avenue, where you'll find upscale shopping, gourmet dining, and local boutiques.Back at the home, indulge in the luxury of a deluxe community pool just steps away. It’s like having a private pool without the hassle, perfect for unwinding or spending quality time with family and friends.Enjoy the perfect outdoor living spaces, from the furnished balcony off the main living area to the outdoor dining area on the back patio, complete with cafe lights for evening ambiance and a BBQ grill. Guests will also enjoy private outdoor balconies off the second-floor master and third-floor king suite.The first floor includes a cozy TV room with a sectional sofa and Smart TV, ideal for movie nights. An additional full bath with a walk-in shower is conveniently located near the laundry room and entry. The home also features an outdoor shower, providing several options for the family post-beach activities.The home is designed to maximize relaxation and entertainment, with multiple living areas perfect for socializing and solitude. The second floor features a gourmet kitchen equipped with high-end appliances, including a gas oven and range. It opens to a spacious dining area with seating for eight and a breakfast bar for four. The main living room on the second floor boasts a Smart TV, SONOS soundbar, fireplace, and access to the balcony, where you can enjoy gorgeous Gulf views. For those who need a quiet space to work or enjoy a friendly game night, an additional card table in the living room offers a flexible area for entertainment or productivity.Sand On Tap comfortably accommodates up to 10 guests with 4 beautifully appointed suites, 5 full bathrooms, and a powder room.1st Floor Bunk Suite: Sleeps 4 in two Twin XL over Twin XL bunks with an en-suite bath with walk-in shower.1st Floor King Suite 1: Features an en-suite bath with a combination shower/tub.2nd Floor King Suite 2: A private balcony with courtyard views, an en-suite bath with a whirlpool tub, walk-in shower, and water closet.3rd Floor King Suite 3: Private balcony with Gulf views and an en-suite bath with combination shower/tubTDT-036644
